purpose: Source and completed raw-capture provenance for the first real Carpet Cleaner ad production pass. Final edited-video QA and publication are separate.

repository.head: 46e9ae8ff49e0388f4b93f587658e64cfb52df80
repository.status_scope: Observed during this production turn before final take rendering. Gameplay modifications and untracked assets predate this provenance audit; capture helpers may already be from the active production turn. The source is intentionally not described as a clean committed release.

toolchain.version_validation: Launcher fail-closed regex ^4\.7\.2\.stable\.mono\.; runtime output must be verified by the capture operator.

capture_plan.status: Completed successfully; see capture_run. Final edited-video export is outside this audit.
capture_plan.input: Normal production input path, with capture-only stroke timestamp correction to the 30 fps render clock when needed.
capture_plan.save_isolation: -- --shop-test; isolated workspace APPDATA and LOCALAPPDATA. Actual user save must not be used.
prohibited_staging: No direct coverage or dirt-power changes
No older staged test stills represented as recorded gameplay
remaining_verification: Final ad hash and export settings
Editorial selected frame ranges and first-frame mapping
Final mixed audio/video sync and playback review
Google Play public listing and build match

paid_rug_order.scope: Fresh paid-job branch, before repeated cycles; per-store manual job count selects the next identity.

dry_cleaning.scope: Ten ideal full-strength passes at one fully contacted spot. Feathered edges and incomplete passes may need more; this is not a guaranteed full-rug duration.

starter_upgrade.scope: Store 1 first tool upgrade with no payout/tool upgrades already applied.

reward.scope: Store 1 payout level zero; reward scales with store and payout upgrades.

completion.soil_polish: Accepted full restoration fades shader dust_strength to zero over the suction. It does not rewrite saved coverage or award an extra reward. Early finish retains residual dirt.

debris.policy: Demand starts reclamation. New extraction uses the current contact; missed extraction is not queued at a historical brush position.

stroke_clock.implication: Offline rendering may take a different wall-clock duration than the captured frame duration. A capture-only timestamp correction is required for faithful speed-dependent dirt impulse/audio.

store_listing.availability: Available on Google Play, confirmed by user
store_listing.note: Do not treat availability as proof that newly recorded local features are already in the public build.

exclusions: Godot import cache and generated shader binaries
Local user saves and save credentials
Marketing assets that may still be edited during production

capture_snapshot.viewport_probe: Successful, reported by capture operator; not run by provenance audit
capture_snapshot.runtime_setup: Capture harness restores Window.CONTENT_SCALE_MODE_VIEWPORT after workshop ready and before first draw. Original project source configuration remains unchanged.

compared_source_files.note: Missing from copy at audit time

capture_snapshot.expected_configuration_difference: project.godot only; recording viewport, preview window, stretch mode and movie output settings.

capture_run.production_input: InputEventScreenTouch and InputEventScreenDrag through root.push_input; one motion per rendered frame
capture_run.clock_normalization: Only the previous brush input timestamp is aligned with fixed movie delta. No calls to manual physics, soil strokes, mask writes or reward setters.

audio.note: Raw footage includes actual brush/completion effects. Music was disabled for capture to allow a continuous editorial music bed later. Equal audio/video duration is a structural check, not a listening review.

final_master.note: Final export and hash are owned by the editor after encoding.
